title: Lunar transfer and orbit insertion
summary: Apollo-class stack: finite translunar injection from a 185 km parking orbit, about three days of N-body coast with JPL DE441 Moon states, finite lunar orbit insertion. No landing is simulated.
expected_behaviour: Continuous propagation from Earth orbit into a closed lunar orbit of roughly 100 x 300 km.
acceptance_checks: Run ends with the Moon as central body.
Propellant remaining is non-negative for every stage.
